**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else" | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Cool and clean" | Flavour description, fine |
| "after a big meal" | Serving occasion. It doesn't say the tea aids digestion, so it isn't a health claim |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the allowlist |

**Slop check:** No ban-list words, no em-dash sandwiches, no exclamation points, no rhetorical opener and no abstract triads. The opening word names the product, and there is no throat-clearing.

**Other checks:** There are no invented stats, testimonials, superlatives, guarantees, urgency or green claims beyond the allowlisted certification. Nothing here needs a disclosure.

One note, not a blocker: if you later add wording like "aids digestion" or "settles your stomach", that becomes a health claim and would need a source.

The draft is clear to publish.
